lines.ruling: Ruling: representation; triage 1,898/1,933 agree, no value difference; differences are candidate-unknown (the reply reads sales.route, which is asked only when sd.route_each is Yes) and candidate-refuses (6 on completed returns: the reply's own consistency refusal of an aggregate route that fails Exception 1, which the project refuses at sales.one through sales.bad_aggregate). i1040sd p. 10, lines 1a and 8a: "You can report on line 1a ... or line 8a ... the aggregate totals from any transactions ... for which" basis was reported and no adjustment shown, and "If you choose to report these transactions on lines 1a and 8a, don't report them on Form 8949": aggregation is the filer's option, and with sd.route_each No every sale is listed on Form 8949 (sales.detail), which the project's choose returns. The reply's note that choose cannot yield an enum value is mistaken (the project's line is such a choose); it ignores the parent question.

Ruling: representation; as the earlier ruling: the reply's value is the project's (reported basis for boxes A, D, G and J; correct basis otherwise). It differs only in hiding the column on the aggregate route; the project carries (e) on every entry because Schedule D lines 1a and 8a total column (e) of the aggregated entries (i1040sd p. 10, Lines 1a and 8a). Triage (this pass): 1,573/1,845 agree; no value difference; 33 candidate-hides-shown (aggregate entries), 237 candidate-unknown (the reply reads sales.route, asked only when sd.route_each is Yes), 2 project-unknown on incomplete records. Rerun because the line sits on the sales form, whose sales.special is now derived from the per-return sd.special_any (BUG-1127); the line itself is unchanged.

Ruling: model error; as the earlier rulings: the reply's own refusal of a code W loss figured from the correct basis refuses entries the project computes (i8949 p. 10, code W, the nondeductible loss entered as a positive adjustment from the broker's or the filer's figure, sales.wash_loss), and it hides the column where no code applies, which on the aggregate route is the project's $0. Triage (this pass): 1,729/1,845 agree; no value difference; 2 candidate-refuses and 3 project-refuses on refused returns, 104 candidate-unknown (sales.route read where unasked), 7 project-unknown on incomplete records. Rerun because the form's sales.special is now derived from sd.special_any (BUG-1127); the line itself is unchanged.

Ruling: model error; (h) is (d) minus (e) plus (g) on both sides; it differs through the reply's (g) (its invented h_wash_excess refusal, ruled model error on (g)) and its hiding of the column on the aggregate route, which Schedule D lines 1a and 8a total (i1040sd p. 10). Triage (pass 60bd5eac256b): 1,824/2,223 agree; no value difference; 9 candidate-refuses (6 completed, h_wash_excess); 82 candidate-hides-shown (aggregate entries); 300 candidate-unknown (sales.route read where unasked); 8 project-unknown on incomplete partial records.
